segments.title: Resident Evil 4 Main Campaign Completion
segments.notes: Case Blackwell plays through the final chapters of the Resident Evil 4 remake, defeating Saddler and rescuing Ashley Graham, concluding the main campaign after an extended castle/island playthrough.

segments.title: Separate Ways DLC Debut
segments.notes: Blackwell purchases and begins the Separate Ways DLC campaign playing as Ada Wong, exploring the castle opening sequence before ending the broadcast.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a solo gaming broadcast, completing the Resident Evil 4 remake main campaign and debuting the Separate Ways DLC.

lore_notes.fact: Reports Kendelle is attending a bachelorette party off-site [00:57].
Mentions impending move from current apartment but states it has not yet occurred [02:04].
Mouse hardware failure noted during gameplay, affecting aim precision [01:07:56].

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell conducts an unscheduled Saturday gaming broadcast, completing the Resident Evil 4 remake main campaign after a months-long playthrough and immediately purchasing the Separate Ways DLC to begin Ada Wong's campaign. No other network personnel appear on-air.
